imageTools.pointerHint: Point, move, or drag the view
imageTools.moveHint: Drag the contents of the active layer
imageTools.handHint: Pan the view — scroll to zoom
imageTools.frameHint: Crop, slice, or section the image
imageTools.cropHint: Redefine the edges of the image
imageTools.sectionHint: Group an area — not available yet
imageTools.sliceHint: Slice an area for export — not available yet
imageTools.penHint: Draw a vector path — not available yet
imageTools.textPathHint: Set text along a path — not available yet
imageTools.commentHint: Leave a note linked to an area of the image
imageTools.regionHint: Mark out an area the tools will be confined to
imageTools.selectRectangleHint: Drag a rectangular selection — Shift for a square
imageTools.selectEllipseHint: Drag an elliptical selection — Shift for a circle
imageTools.smartSelectHint: Select an object with the local selection model
imageTools.smartSelectClickHint: Click an object to select it precisely
imageTools.smartSelectBoxHint: Draw a box around an object to select it precisely
imageTools.shapeHint: Draw a shape on the active layer
imageTools.shapeRectangleHint: Drag a rectangle — Shift for a square
imageTools.shapeLineHint: Drag a line — Shift to snap it to 45°
imageTools.shapeArrowHint: Drag an arrow — Shift to snap it to 45°
imageTools.shapeEllipseHint: Drag an ellipse — Shift for a circle
imageTools.shapePolygonHint: Drag a regular polygon out from its centre
imageTools.shapeStarHint: Drag a star out from its centre
imageTools.shapeImageHint: Open the library to place an image on a layer
imageTools.brushHint: Paint with the current colour, soft edge
imageTools.pencilHint: Paint with the current colour, crisp edge
imageTools.textHint: Click to place text on the active layer
imageTools.fillHint: Fill the whole active layer, or the selection when there is one
imageTools.pickerHint: Pick up the colour under the pointer
imageTools.colorHint: Colour of the brush, the shapes and the fill
imageTools.aiHint: Prepares an edit, the form opens filled in, and you are the one who runs it
imageTools.brushSettingsHint: Size and opacity of the stroke — hardness is offered under the brush alone, the one tool that feathers its edge

imageComments.removeHint: Removes this note from the generation context
imageComments.generateHint: Starts a generation with this note only

imageView.fitHint: Fit the image to the window
imageView.actualHint: Actual size — one image pixel per screen pixel

imageEdit.maskIgnored: This model takes no mask, so the whole image will be regenerated.

layers.addHint: Add a transparent layer on top of the stack
layers.removeHint: Delete the active layer — the last one cannot go
layers.hideHint: Hide this layer without deleting it
layers.noDocument: Open an image to see its layers.
layers.locksHint: Lock the pixels, the position or the transparency
layers.operationsHint: What can be done with the active layer — group, duplicate, mask a region of it
layers.renameHint: Opens the layer’s name to be typed over, as a double-click on it does
layers.groupHint: Puts the active layer into a new group
layers.ungroupHint: Takes the layers out of the group and removes the group
layers.duplicateHint: Copies the active layer just above itself

mirror.title: Video return
mirror.waiting: Waiting for the studio. Open an edit to see it here.

styles.none: No style saved yet. Set a material up, then save it from the inspector.
styles.saveHint: Keeps the current material settings, without its maps, to replay on another material.
styles.applyHint: Puts these settings back on the open material, leaving its channels alone
styles.renameHint: Changes the saved style’s name, leaving what it holds alone
styles.removeHint: Takes the style off the list; documents already using it keep their settings

adjustment.addHint: Lay an adjustment layer over what is below it
adjustment.exposureHint: Brightens or darkens everything below it
adjustment.contrastHint: Pushes light and dark tones apart, or brings them together
adjustment.saturationHint: Revives the colours or drains them, down to grey
adjustment.temperatureHint: Warms towards orange or cools towards blue

text.noCaption: Pick a text layer, or draw one with the Text tool.
